short: A prayer journal for daily prayer, Scripture and praying together.
paragraphs: Qetoret is a Christian prayer companion for bringing what is on your heart before God, returning to prayer with intention and remembering answers over time.

Start a quiet prayer moment without an account. Sign in to save requests in your personal journal. Write prayers for yourself or others, add updates and notes, and record answered prayers and testimonies.
Build a rhythm with prayers for today, recurring schedules, a calendar and optional reminders. Explore guided prayer plans, Bible passages and readings, and keep your reflections as you go.

Create or join prayer groups. Share selected requests with their members, carry one another's prayers and encourage each other with updates. Add photos, voice recordings or video to supported updates and testimonies.

Private journal content is encrypted in your browser before upload. Group content is encrypted for its members, who can read and keep what you share. Set up optional vault recovery before changing devices or browsers so you can unlock your encrypted journal there.
An account is needed for syncing and community features. Some journal actions work offline and sync when a connection returns. Sign-in, media uploads and other online features need internet access.
Qetoret is free to use and offers 16 interface languages. Android 7.0 or later is required.
